name: Isik Ulusan
bio: I’m a senior interesting in complexity theory and related fields, but especially interactive proof systems. I am currently working on streaming algorithms in an interactive proof systems setting. Feel free to reach out if you have any questions about complexity theory or TCS in general!

name: August Singh
bio: My name’s August, and I’m a Computer Science and Pure Math dual degree student! I’m interested in Information Theory, Algorithms and Finite group theory. I’m from Bangalore, India and Austin, Texas. I love playing chess, learning about math and rock climbing. I also have 2 huskies. I’ll see you in the Fall:)

name: Quinn Mayo
bio: I’m a PhD student at Simon Fraser University studying computational complexity theory and logic. Previously, I was an undergraduate and master’s student at UMass where I helped start and run the Theory Club. I plan to continue contributing to the club remotely for a while.
